backdrop.help: A background every chapter scene starts on (a scene's own backdrop overrides it).

rules.help: What happens to fallen units and to a lost battle.

fallen.help: gone: a unit that falls is lost for good; return: it is back next chapter.

onDefeat.help: retry: the chapter can be played again; end: the campaign is over.

freeBattles.help: Single maps next to the campaign: none, all, some, or with a condition.

node.help: The maps that may be played on their own.

when.help: always: from the start; storyComplete: after the story is finished.

lockedNote.help: The text shown while free battles are still locked.

parties.help: Groups of characters that play different chapters (leave out for one roster).

id.help: Unique id (letters, digits, _ and -); chapters and commands name it.

name.help: Name shown to the player (default: the id).

chapters.help: The chapters in play order (at least one).

name.help: Name shown on the chapter card (default: the id).

map.help: The map this chapter is played on.

next.help: The chapter that follows (default: the next in the list); a goto in the after scene can choose another.

before.help: The scene that plays before the battle.

after.help: The scene that plays after the battle.
